notes: QuantumCanaryHook funds the Quantum Canary bounty on Ethereum mainnet. Constructor arguments are IPoolManager manager and IQuantumCanary canary, in that order; both are immutable. It reads canaryAddress() once at construction into an immutable destination. QuantumCanaryToken has no constructor arguments and uses plain ERC-20 transfers. The hook has no owner, admin, fee setter, pause, upgrade or withdrawal function. All implemented PoolManager callbacks reject other callers. The five declared permissions encode address mask 0x20cc. beforeInitialize accepts native ETH as currency0, a nonzero token as currency1, this hook, fee 12500 and tick spacing 60; it does not restrict the initializer or bind to a particular token. The declared pool pairs CANARY with native ETH. initialPrice records the required 1:1 reference sqrtPriceX96; the factory derives the actual opening price from launch policy. The constant hook fee is additional to the pool's 1.25% LP fee and is always native ETH: floor(total ETH paid / 100) for buys and floor(gross ETH output / 100) for sells. ETH-specified swaps use a positive specified beforeSwap delta and a reverting quote against the same pool to account for partial fills. For full fills, exact-input buys reserve floor(input / 100), and exact-output sells gross up net ETH output by floor(net output / 99). Other swaps use a positive afterSwap delta: floor(AMM ETH input / 99) for exact-output buys and floor(gross ETH output / 100) for exact-input sells. All hook fees first accrue as native ETH ERC-6909 claims, id 0, held by the hook in the PoolManager. afterSwap attempts redemption when manager funds and callback gas permit; payout failure leaves claims intact without reverting the swap. Anyone may call payout() to burn available claims and send ETH exclusively to the immutable canary address, including after router settlement or retirement. No caller can choose another recipient; 100% of redeemed hook fees goes to the bounty. beforeSwap and afterSwap read isTripped() with a bounded staticcall; failure or malformed data is treated as not tripped. The first true observation permanently retires fee collection. Verify the immutable getters, retired(), accruedFees(), PoolManager claim balances, FeeAccrued and BountyPaid events, and ETH received by canaryAddress() to trace the flow.
